text: The Claude adapter v0.101.0 sends no time with any message chunk, live or replayed on `session/load`. `replaySessionHistory` passes each history message to `toAcpNotifications`, which sets only `content`, `messageId` and `_meta.claudeCode.parentToolUseId`. The `timestamp` in its transcript files stays inside the adapter. So a loaded session's older messages show no time in coax. Source: `replaySessionHistory` and `toAcpNotifications` in the adapter's `src/acp-agent.ts`.
